basic_info.description: Discover classic San Francisco charm at 390 Guerrero Street, a beautifully updated 2+ bedroom, 1-bath condo in the heart of the vibrant Mission District. This 828 sq ft residence blends historic details like high ceilings, wainscotting, and original hardwood floors with contemporary upgrades for a warm, inviting atmosphere. The spacious kitchen is equipped with designer appliances and pantry, while the layout flows seamlessly for relaxing evenings or inviting company. Two fireplaces (one decorative, one functional) add character, while a bonus room offers flexibility for a home office, or additional bedroom. Thoughtful updates include stylish bathroom, in-unit laundry and water heater (2022). Additional storage in the building ensures ample space for belongings. Centrally located just three blocks from Mission Dolores, Whole Foods, Safeway, Tartine, Delfina, and Bi-Rite. Step out your door to vibrant restaurants and shops on 16th Street and the Valencia Street corridor. Enjoy easy access to MUNI, BART, and 101/280 freeways. With a 99 Walk Score, this is ultimate San Francisco convenience and charm at every turn.
